items.title: Labari opens: a public watch on AI, read from Softanza's point of view
items.summary: Softanza opened Labari, a public repository that reads developments in AI at their source and judges each one against what Softanza builds. Every entry is written twice in one file, as a page for people and as data for programs, and a feed is generated from the data.

notice.developer: Softanza now keeps a public watch on AI developments: read it on GitHub, or fetch feed/index.json to show its notices in your own tools.
notice.learner: There is now one place that explains, in plain words, what changes in AI mean for what you learn with Softanza.
notice.maintainer: Labari is open: send it the AI developments that touch your project, and expect the tasks it proposes to reach you through Bangalo.

actions.do: run the first weekly survey and publish its digest
propose a command that reads this feed for its user's audience and level
